name: MultiMaskAttentionAggregation
reference:
import torch

def run(attn, ref_target_masks, mode="mean"):
    x_ref_attn_map_source = attn.softmax(-1)
    ref_target_masks = ref_target_masks.to(attn.dtype)
    x_ref_attn_map_source = x_ref_attn_map_source.to(attn.dtype)
    x_ref_attn_maps = []
    for class_idx, ref_target_mask in enumerate(ref_target_masks):
        ref_target_mask = ref_target_mask[None, None, None, ...]
        x_ref_attnmap = x_ref_attn_map_source * ref_target_mask
        x_ref_attnmap = x_ref_attnmap.sum(-1) / ref_target_mask.sum()
        x_ref_attnmap = x_ref_attnmap.permute(0, 2, 1)
        if mode == "mean":
            x_ref_attnmap = x_ref_attnmap.mean(-1)
        elif mode == "max":
            x_ref_attnmap = x_ref_attnmap.max(-1)[0]
        x_ref_attn_maps.append(x_ref_attnmap)
    return torch.stack(x_ref_attn_maps, dim=0)
description: Multi-mask attention aggregation with softmax normalization. Applies softmax to attention scores, then for each class mask: weighted sum normalized by mask sum, dimension permutation (B,H,S) -> (B,S,H), and head aggregation (mean or max). Returns tensor of shape (num_classes, B, x_seq_len).
